evals.name: install-dry-run-then-commit
evals.prompt: Enforce that a workload tolerating a taint also pins where it lands.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight`, previews `cub manage scheduling guardrails install` (dry-run: Trigger, spaces to wire, skips), then on confirmation `guardrails install --commit`. Trigger is Warn=true (advisory), not blocking by default.

evals.name: status
evals.prompt: Which workloads are flagged by the placement guardrails?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage guardrails status` and reports Units with ValidationWarnings/ValidationErrors. Read-only.

evals.name: routes-fix-elsewhere
evals.expected_output: Routes to scheduling-place to remediate (set-node-selector / set-node-affinity / a placement profile), rather than fixing from the guardrails skill.

evals.name: spread-rules
evals.prompt: Warn on workloads whose topology spread constraints don't select their own Pods, or set minDomains without DoNotSchedule.
evals.expected_output: Previews `cub manage scheduling guardrails install` (dry-run), which includes the scheduling-spread-selects-own-pods and scheduling-min-domains-needs-donotschedule rules, then `--commit` on confirmation; notes the rules are Warn=true and that checks needing cluster facts (unknown topology key, minDomains above the zone count) are in `cub manage scheduling findings`.
